arguments.message: I’m sorry to hear this happened. Please go to **Settings → Developer → Webhooks** in your workspace and either disable the webhook or repoint it to a safe endpoint – this stops any further deliveries right away. After you’ve done that, please let our support team know (via a support ticket or reply) so we can investigate when the endpoint was changed, which account made the change, and what data may have been delivered to the unauthorized domain.
